preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 1000.
The number of edges must be exactly n-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the vertex r where Kuroni's hotel is located.
The number of queries must not exceed ⌊ n/2 ⌋.
All responses from the app must be valid and not -1, indicating no invalid queries or exceeding the query limit.
